items.title: secrets: exec SecretRef rejects root-owned commands, making /usr/bin/security (macOS keychain) unusable in 2026.8.1
items.desc:
## Summary

In 2026.8.1, exec `SecretRef` resolution requires the resolver command to be owned by the invoking uid.
